# 3D fold: faces as normals. Column along y folds: Bat(top of column), Net, Stick, Goal
# place Net as front (0,0,1); moving down column rotates about x-axis
faces={}
seq=['Bat','Net','Stick','Goal']
normals=[(0,1,0),(0,0,1),(0,-1,0),(0,0,-1)]
for f,n in zip(seq,normals): faces[f]=n

# Field is right of Goal on the net; Goal normal (0,0,-1): right side of net folds to +x
faces['Field']=(1,0,0)
assert len(set(faces.values()))==6
opp=[f for f,n in faces.items() if n==tuple(-x for x in faces['Ball'])][0]
opts={'A':'Bat','B':'Stick','C':'Goal','D':'Field'}
assert opp==opts['D']
assert all(opp!=v for k,v in opts.items() if k!='D')

steps: S * F: S is wife of F; F & J: F is brother of J
J ! I: J is father of I; I # M: I is daughter of M, so M is I's mother and J's wife
So S is the wife of M's husband's brother
A, B, D start with S & (S is a brother, male), so cannot be a wife
check_code:
def rel(expr):
    t=expr.split(); ppl=t[0::2]; ops=t[1::2]
    male=set(); female=set(); father={}; spouse={}; bro={}; parent={}
    for a,o,b in zip(ppl,ops,ppl[1:]):
        if o=='!': male.add(a); parent.setdefault(b,set()).add(a)
        if o=='&': male.add(a); bro[a]=b
        if o=='*': female.add(a); male.add(b); spouse[a]=b; spouse[b]=a
        if o=='#': female.add(a); parent.setdefault(a,set()).add(b)
    if male & female: return False
    # need: S wife of X, X brother of H, H husband of M
    S='S'; M='M'
    if S not in female or S not in spouse: return False
    X=spouse[S]
    if X not in bro: return False
    H=bro[X]
    if spouse.get(H)==M: return True
    # H and M co-parents of a child, H male -> H husband of M
    kids=[c for c,ps in parent.items() if H in ps and M in ps]
    return bool(kids) and H in male and M not in male
opts={'A':'S & F * J ! I # M','B':'S & F ! J * I # M','C':'S * F & J ! I # M','D':'S & F # J ! I * M'}
good=[k for k,v in opts.items() if rel(v)]
assert good==['C']
